title: The dark side of AI generated influencers

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What risks emerge when AI-generated influencers shape public opinion and consumer behavior?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Deepfake avatars, voice cloning, and emotion-sensing AI can now create hyper-realistic, persuasive digital personas.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: These influencers may manipulate emotions, erode trust, and blur the line between authenticity and deception in media and advertising.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: We're embedding watermarking, transparency labels, and AI detection tools to help users identify synthetic content.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: With ethical guidelines and AI literacy, these tools could empower users and restore trust in digital personas.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future hinges on balancing innovation with responsibility in AI-generated influence.
